exposure: focused ultrasound ablation surgery (FUAS) combined with suction curettage under hysteroscopic guidance
outcome: decline rates of b-human chorionic gonadotropin
cohort: The study included 78 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who received treatment between 2017 and 2023.
finding: Both focused ultrasound ablation surgery combined with curettage and transvaginal debridement and repair surgery were safe and effective for treating Cesarean scar pregnancy, with TDRS showing advantages in shorter hospitalization and lower costs.
